commands.label: alpine-usb-autoboot-setup
commands.note: Check/download Alpine ISO, build apkovl overlay for Claude CLI autoboot, write ventoy.json and README. All hidden, no popups.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$iso = 'alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso'; $vdrive = $null; foreach ($d in @('D:','E:')) { if (Test-Path $d) { $vdrive = $d; break } }; if (-not $vdrive) { Write-Output 'NO_VENTOY_DRIVE'; exit 1 }; $isoPath = "$vdrive\$iso"; if (-not (Test-Path $isoPath)) { Write-Output 'DOWNLOADING_ISO'; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://dl-cdn.alpinelinux.org/alpine/v3.24/releases/x86_64/alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso' -OutFile $isoPath -UseBasicParsing } else { Write-Output 'ISO_EXISTS' }; $ovl = "$env:TEMP\alpine_ovl"; if (Test-Path $ovl) { Remove-Item $ovl -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$ovl\etc\local.d" | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$ovl\etc\runlevels\default" | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$ovl\root" | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\etc\inittab", "::sysinit:/sbin/openrc sysinit`n::sysinit:/sbin/openrc boot`n::wait:/sbin/openrc default`ntty1::respawn:/sbin/agetty --autologin root --noclear tty1 linux`ntty2::respawn:/sbin/agetty 38400 tty2 linux`n::shutdown:/sbin/openrc shutdown`n"); [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\etc\local.d\10-claude.start", "#!/bin/sh`napk add --no-cache nodejs npm 2>/dev/null`nnpm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code 2>/dev/null`nchmod +x /etc/local.d/10-claude.start`n"); New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path "$ovl\etc\runlevels\default\local" | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$ovl\root\.profile", ". ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null; clear; echo 'Alpine Claude CLI Boot'; echo '--------------------'; if command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1; then claude; else echo 'Installing Claude CLI...'; apk add --no-cache nodejs npm && npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code && claude; fi`n"); Set-Location $ovl; $tarOut = "$vdrive\localhost.apkovl.tar.gz"; tar -czf $tarOut .; Write-Output "APKOVL_WRITTEN:$tarOut"; $ventoyJson = @{ menu_alias = @(@{ image = "/$iso"; alias = 'Alpine Linux - Claude CLI Boot' }); theme = @{ default_file = '0'; display_mode = 'CLI' } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$vdrive\ventoy\ventoy.json", $ventoyJson); Write-Output 'VENTOY_JSON_WRITTEN'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$vdrive\claude_boot" | Out-Null; [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("$vdrive\claude_boot\README.txt", "Alpine Linux Claude CLI Autoboot`n==============================`nISO: $iso`nBoot: F12 at startup, select USB, pick Alpine Linux entry`nFirst boot: installs nodejs/npm/claude (~2 min, needs internet)`nSubsequent boots: launches claude directly`nOverlay: localhost.apkovl.tar.gz (auto-login root + claude setup)`nBuilt: 2026-10-28 by Cloud Coordinator`n"); Write-Output 'README_WRITTEN'; Set-Location $env:TEMP; Remove-Item $ovl -Recurse -Force"
